web.description:
# Low and middle income earner tax offsets
## LMITO amounts 2021–22 income year
| Taxable income | Offset |
|-|-|
| From $37,001 to $48,000 | $675 plus 7.5 cents for every dollar above $37,000, up to a maximum of $1,500 |
| From $48,001 to $90,000 | $1,500 |
| From $90,001 to $126,000* | $1,500 minus 3 cents for every dollar above $90,000 |

### Examples of how the offsets reduce your tax
#### Example: taxable income over $90,000 but under $126,000
He is eligible for a low and middle income tax offset amount of $1,500 minus 3 cents for every dollar his income is above $90,000.

web.description:
# Low and middle income earner tax offsets
## Eligibility for the tax offsets
**low and middle income tax offset** – if you earn up to $126,000.

## Low income tax offset (LITO)
between $37,501 and $45,000, you will get $700 minus 5 cents for every $1 above $37,500

## Low and middle income tax offset (LMITO)
receive it if your taxable income is $126,000 or more.

### LMITO amounts 2021–22 income year
| Taxable income | Offset |
|-|-|
| From $48,001 to $90,000 | $1,500 |
| From $90,001 to $126,000* | $1,500 minus 3 cents for every dollar above $90,000 |

#### Examples of how the offsets reduce your tax
##### Example: taxable income over $48,000 but under $90,000
she is eligible for a low and middle income tax offset of $1,500.
